intake.matter_summary: Former employer Northlake Surgical Instruments moved for a temporary injunction to enforce a one-year non-compete and eighteen-month non-solicitation covenant against Ms. Okwuosa, alleging she copied a customer-pricing spreadsheet before resigning to join a competitor. Firm engaged to oppose the injunction.
intake.referral_source: referral from a former Ellingboe & Ravndal client

conflicts_check.notes: No prior or current representation of Northlake, Verdant, or Rennick & Vao. No firm relationship with Ms. Danneker. No positional conflict identified.

time_entries.narrative: Initial client interview; preliminary case assessment and intake of the employment agreement, cease-and-desist letter, and IT export log.
Preliminary research on temporary-injunction standard and enforceability of restrictive covenants; outline of defense theory.
Review of pricing-spreadsheet handling; interview of witness Mareike Hollis regarding shared-drive access and routine emailing of the file.
Interview of Verdant hiring manager Curtis Bellweather; review of Verdant offer letter and job description; chronology development.
Draft statement of facts for memorandum opposing temporary injunction; analysis of non-compete scope, geography, and duration.
Research on trade-secret protectability and reasonable-measures requirement as applied to loosely guarded pricing data.
Draft argument section: likelihood of success and distinction between non-compete and non-solicitation clauses.
Draft argument on irreparable harm, balance of equities, and public interest in labor mobility.
Prepare client declaration; interview witness Dr. Elena Marchetti regarding absence of solicitation; revise memorandum.
Prepare declaration of André Dupont analysis; cite-check and edit memorandum against rubric.
Client counseling session on risk arising from copied file and forwarded email; discussion of options including narrowed resolution.
Draft proposed order and finalize supporting declarations; assemble exhibits for filing.
Final revisions to memorandum opposing temporary injunction; prepare argument outline for hearing.
Hearing preparation: moot the injunction argument, refine responses on trade-secret protectability and covenant overbreadth.
